notes.title: Public Playtests for The Skyland Chronicles – August 25–31!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Public Playtests for [i]The Skyland Chronicles[/i] – August 25–31, 2025[/b][/h2][p]Step aboard the [i]Old Harlot[/i] and see what we’ve been working on in [i]The Skyland Chronicles[/i].[/p][p]For 7 days only — from August 25 to 31 — we’re opening the doors to public playtests.[/p][h3]This is your chance to experience the game before the official demo drops in October!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44688802/11c8eaafd31a34690594129817343122e6d0f810.png"][/img]
[b]What’s in the Playtests?[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The opening chapter that introduces you to the world of Skyland.[/p][/*][*][p]A “simple but deep” soulslike combat system and easy to pick up, hard to master.[/p][/*][*][p]A world inspired by the Golden Age of Piracy, full of choices, secrets, and narrative twists.[/p][/*][*][p]And yes — even in the Playtest, you can miss something… or choose the wrong path.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]

Why Play Now?[/b][/h3][p]After August 31, the playtest version will be gone.[/p][p]This is a short, one-time opportunity.[/p][p]If you want to experience the game early and help us make it even better — you’re in the right place.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44688802/aff377eb04cc8017e15118cdd4d191f689cb5827.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Want to Help Us Improve the Game?[/b][/h3][p]At the end of the playtest, you’ll see a short feedback form.[/p][p]We’ll also post the same questions on our Discord — so if you’d rather share your thoughts with other players or join the conversation in real time, hop on the server:
[/p][p]👉[url="https://discord.gg/5u8uMhKfdz"]https://discord.gg/5u8uMhKfdz[/url][/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44688802/1a7c7d7f49b258c7aff5b661f630e9b283b3ee17.png"][/img]
[b]For Content Creators and Streamers[/b][/h3][p]If you’re planning to share content from the game — we truly appreciate it! However, we kindly ask that you hold off on publishing any gameplay, screenshots, or story-related materials from this version.[/p][p]The official content window for creators is [b]September 20 – October 15[/b].[/p][h3]During that time, you’ll be able to showcase the game before the free Steam demo goes live and be among the first to tell the world about [i]The Skyland Chronicles[/i].
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44688802/4988544ffd3c0c9c6622d08c8f0362c6669a3e4e.png"][/img] [b]P.S. A Few Words from Us[/b][/h3][p]We’re a small indie team from Poland.[/p][p]Three years ago, the five of us dropped everything to work on this game.[/p][p]If you enjoy what we’ve created, consider following us and adding the game to your wishlist — it really means a lot and helps us stand out among bigger titles.[/p][p]If you like the playtest, keep a close eye on us.[/p][p]Something bigger is coming soon… and it’ll take this story even further.[/p]

notes.title: Concept of pickpocketing
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Skylanders! Just wanted to share a concept of pickpocketing we’re working on in our roguelike pirate game.[/h2]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44688802/47b22fb64ef4bf97462ab84d8884a78dd363b724.gif[/img]

[h3]Pickpocketing Mechanism Guide[/h3]

[b]1. Approaching the Target[/b]

- To maximize your chances of a successful theft, approach the target unnoticed.

- The best approach is from behind, especially for NPCs who are drunk or asleep, as they have slower reaction times.

[b]2. Time Pressure[/b]

- Each target has a set time limit before realizing they are being pickpocketed.

- A ticking clock will appear on the screen, counting down the time until detection.

- If you don't exit the interaction before time runs out, a confrontation will occur – the NPC may attack you or alert the guards.

[b]3. Memory Game – Matching Items[/b]

- When you open the target’s inventory, you’ll see the item layout by clicking on coin images.

- Clicking a coin flips it over, revealing an item for a brief moment. If the selected pair of coins does not match, they both return to their original position.

- You need to remember item positions and find two identical ones to steal them.

- Every incorrect match increases the risk of detection and may shorten the available time.

- Choose quickly and wisely – not all items are worth the risk!

[b]4. Completing the Theft[/b]

- If you successfully match items and exit the interaction before time runs out, the theft is successful.

- A notification will appear on the screen showing the stolen items.

- If you remain undetected, the target won’t realize they were robbed.

- If caught, you can try to escape or prepare for a confrontation.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44688802/234784165230709aaf21e27a174502ad19d4f301.png[/img]

notes.title: Concept of lockpickping
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Skylanders! Just wanted to share a concept of lockpickping we’re working on in our roguelike pirate game. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44688802/6be3eccbdd03767c844fbcfd826de9fe68ffdd5a.gif[/img]

[b]Lockpicking Mechanism Instructions[/b]

1. Begin with the Green Ball: Place the green-colored ball into a slot at the starting position. This ball represents the tension in the lock and should be the first point of contact.

2. Watch for Tension: As you rotate the lockpick, the ball will gradually change color. It will first stay green, indicating low tension, but as you continue to rotate, the ball will move toward yellow, orange, and finally red. The color change represents increasing tension, with red indicating that the lock is about to break.

3. Align the Notches: Your goal is to align two notches within the lock. You’ll need to repeat the process of inserting and rotating the ball through the slots, taking care to remove it before it reaches red, and continuing to rotate it until the notches are perfectly aligned.

4. Completion: Once both notches are aligned, the lock will release, and you will successfully pick the lock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44688802/cc9597dbfde9c4e2930fbf5d9e02fb04e1f9546b.png[/img]

[b]What do you think?[/b]

notes.title: Into the Depths: New Dangers and Secrets Await in The Skyland Chronicles
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44688802/79dfbf31bbf99d00c45c70525466693448c29e98.png[/img]

[h1]Our team, as small as it may be, has been laboring in the shadows to bring you something unforgettable. These new features? [/h1]

[b]🌟 Fist Fight Arena:[/b] The sound of fists pounding flesh, the rush of adrenaline as you lock eyes with your opponent. This isn’t just combat; this is survival. The Fist Fight Arena is a place where only the strongest—physically and mentally—will stand. And if you think it’s just a game, think again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44688802/2769c94234cf41f1a5899c31439634925d05c6f5.gif[/img]

[b]🍽️ Mess Hall: [/b]Beneath the flickering lights, you’ll gather with your crew. But don’t be fooled by the warmth of the meals, the clink of the dishes, or the laughter echoing against the walls. In the Mess Hall, bonds are made... and broken. Uncover secrets, unlock hidden stories, and dive deeper into the labyrinth of the game world. The food’s not the only thing served here—some things are better left unspoken.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44688802/7ee7fdd75bbf24259223285a16aeaf790402218b.gif[/img]

So, what do you think? Will you face these new challenges head-on? Or will the shadows swallow you whole? [b]Add The Skyland Chronicles to your wishlist[/b], and prepare for the dark, thrilling journey that awaits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44688802/e544be6f827c63baaa21b7f62b67bf5d65bc4f78.png[/img]

notes.title: Explore the Diary – Your Adventure Awaits!
notes.content:
[b]📖 What’s in the Diary? Only one way to find out![/b]

We’re thrilled to introduce the Diary, one of the core features of The Skyland Chronicles! This menu allows players to dive deep into character stories, follow their progress, and uncover secrets that enrich the pirate-slavic universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44688802/37a30e2ed1082e644a9d1af0ac9cb2dd7b8cfe5f.png[/img]

🔑 What makes it special?

📜 Hand-drawn character portraits that capture the unique era and style of our world.
🗂️ A clean and intuitive design, making it easy to immerse yourself in the story.
🧩 Uncover hidden connections between events and characters to deepen your adventure.
🌌 A narrative that makes every moment unforgettable.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44688802/37a30e2ed1082e644a9d1af0ac9cb2dd7b8cfe5f.png[/img]
